statement.zh: Chu 2011 以家庭单位发掘班杜里亚居住区（5×5 m 探方），区分方形石结构与易朽椭圆棚屋，并以 AMS 年代补充 Fung 1970s 测年。
statement.en: Chu 2011 excavates Bandurria domestic sector at household scale (5×5 m units), distinguishing quadrangular stone structures from perishable oval huts, with AMS dates complementing Fung’s 1970s radiocarbon.
